description: This Java class 'CORSHeaders' manages Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers for HTTP requests and responses within the mockserver project. It handles preflight request detection and adds appropriate CORS headers based on configuration and request details.

classes.name: CORSHeaders
classes.description: A class that encapsulates CORS header management, including configuration and adding headers to HTTP responses.

methods.name: CORSHeaders
methods.description: Constructor initializing CORS headers with specific parameters or from a Configuration object.

methods.name: isPreflightRequest
methods.description: Static method to determine if an HTTP request is a CORS preflight request based on headers and method.

methods.name: addCORSHeaders
methods.description: Adds appropriate CORS headers to an HTTP response based on the request and configuration.

methods.name: setHeaderIfNotAlreadyExists
methods.description: Helper method to set a header on the response if it does not already exist.
